scope: Final Stage-2 transfer-continuity identity and the exact pinned JAX-MD repository snapshot were inspected statically. Repository role, installation, package metadata, multi-backend environment scope, examples and bundled assets were source-scoped.

unresolved_findings.finding: The repository specifies ranged core dependencies and optional dependency groups rather than one exact unified environment lock.
CPU/GPU/TPU support depends on backend-specific JAX/JAXLIB installation and no single hardware/backend target is pinned for all repository capabilities.

Heterogeneous notebooks, examples and bundled model/checkpoint assets are preserved as framework capability evidence but are not individually normalized in this bounded supporting-software extraction.
Pinned documentation and project metadata retain historical google/jax-md URLs; Stage-2 authority establishes these as transfer continuity for the same resource, not a second identity.
Repository examples and framework publications do not establish an Atlas-paper experiment relationship and are not promoted to Stage-3 experiments or configurations.

notes: No explicit conflict is introduced by this checkpoint.
